hints.title: Tracking Bracket Balance Discrepancy
hints.text: Traverse the string maintaining a running count of unmatched opening brackets.

hints.title: Canceling Matched Pairs
hints.text: When encountering an opening bracket, increment balance. When encountering a closing bracket, decrement balance if balance is positive.

hints.title: Calculating Minimum Swaps
hints.text: Each swap resolves two pairs of mismatched brackets; the required swaps is (unmatched_openings + 1) // 2.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy simulated swapping with full string mutations takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Integer counter replaces explicit stack data structure with O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that each swap resolves two mismatched pairs simultaneously.
